qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Niche specifications, proprietary formulations, and strict qualification testing in precision engineered polymer seals (TSS) where failure costs far exceed component prices.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Specialized engineered polymer seals operate in cyclical industrial and automotive end markets. High dependence on continuous bolt-on M&A to replace fading legacy product lines and exposure to automotive powertrain transition cap competitive advantage persistence at 10 years.
qualitative.evidence: Divestment of Wheel Systems in 2023 improved ROCE to 12-13% (excl. goodwill ~24%) and EBITA margins to 17-18%. However, Mauboussin capital goods base-rate persistence fades rapidly given cyclical end markets and ongoing reliance on serial bolt-on acquisitions.
